shared_schema.input: Strict JSON envelope: schema_version, synthetic=true, records, research. Records contain exactly one Patient, DocumentReference clinical note and draft Claim preauthorization with consistent patient references. Research contains urls and an exact corresponding fixtures map.
shared_schema.output: Versioned synthetic envelope with status, human_review_required=true, clinical_decision=not-performed, annotated records, source snapshots, quoted findings and record-change audit.
shared_schema.validation: One shared module validates input, output, all resources, source provenance and audits. Unknown record fields, identifiers, birth dates, arbitrary clinical note text, nonfinite numbers and duplicate JSON keys are rejected.
shared_schema.fixtures: Fictitious Synthea-style patient with ICD-style diagnosis and LOINC-style glucose lab; no real names, MRNs or birth dates. This is FHIR-style JSON, not conformant full HL7 FHIR.
shared_schema.deidentification: Demonstrative identifier exclusion: narrow synthetic IDs, broad age bands, strict field whitelist and three identifier-free clinical note templates. No general free-text deidentifier or HIPAA certification is claimed.

cross_stage_handoffs: Shared validation accepts synthetic resources and canonical URLs.
Allowlist ingestion hands URLs to offline fixture retrieval.
Retrieval hands original source text, URL and SHA-256 to deterministic excerpt extraction.
Findings retain exact quotes and Unicode character offsets into stored source bodies.
Human-review annotation creates a before/after audit event for every changed record; final shared validation checks the entire result.

behavior.retrieval: Local plain-text fixture retrieval only, no network, redirects, HTML execution or live provider.
behavior.limits: 1-5 unique canonical HTTPS URLs, 5000 characters and 20 lines per source, 100000-byte CLI input, exactly three clinical resources.
behavior.findings: Every nonblank source line is an uninterpreted source excerpt, never a clinical recommendation. Retrieved text is untrusted source material, not an instruction.
behavior.clinical_safety: No diagnosis, treatment, eligibility, approval or denial decisions. Claims remain draft and all outputs require human review.
behavior.audit: Deterministic ordered events include full before/after resource snapshots and SHA-256 digests; every resource annotation is checked. Audit is per execution, not a durable cross-run ledger.
behavior.errors: File, JSON and validation errors return one redacted JSON object with status error and exit code 2. Success returns one JSON object and exit code 0.
behavior.determinism: No timestamps, randomness, external calls or LLM. Same input yields identical output and the caller's input is not mutated.

test_outcomes.verified: Both documented commands were executed successfully; CLI error behavior is covered by the test suite.
